enrichment_usage_today.note: Reserved ID units come from radar_api_budget_daily (ledger not reset when limits change).

enrichment_dry_run_pass.note: Dry-run: no ledger reservation, no HTTP. http_batches_* is the batch count that would run (50 IDs per batch).

enrichment_pending_queue.note: Due counts use same selection rules as a live pass (dedup, cooldown, backoff).

monitoring.metric: sum(selected_request_count) on monitoring_cycle_runs for UTC day

outcome_capture.metric: sum(selected_video_count) on outcome_capture_cycle_runs for UTC day

quota_and_rate_limit_errors.note: No dedicated quota/rate-limit error table. YouTube client tries each configured API key once per HTTP call, then raises YouTubeApiError.

explanation_49_vs_50: diagnose_format_enrichment_selection считает видео на subscriber_touched_channel_ids (все каналы из channels.list batch). format selection после фикса ограничен eligible_channel_ids = channels_with_known_subs_at_most(touched) — без каналов >100k. Поэтому 49 «подходящих» на touched vs 50 format IDs: один linked-video на over-cap канале в diagnose, но не попадает в eligible-пул отбора; 50-й format ID — видео с eligible-канала (не тот же video_id, что отсеян по subs_over_cap в diagnose).

notes.sort_patterns: channel_count desc, breakout_video_count desc, videos_last_24h desc, video_count desc, pattern_key
notes.sort_pattern_families: channel_count desc, support_sources count desc, breakout_eligible_count desc, last_24h desc, video_count desc, family_key
notes.pattern_family_identity: reuse stored family_key when membership grows; mint family:{kind}:{core-hash} when unseen
notes.sort_channels: recent_improvement_count desc, age_aligned_vph_ratio desc, recent_measurable_count desc, channel_id
notes.radar_target_eligibility_counting: per window AttentionVideoRecord (one row per video_id in bundle.records); rejections.stream counts videos with content_format=LIVE in DB
